criteria.description: Clear hierarchy and deliberately composed sections across page types
criteria.observations: Distinct homepage, investor, overview and editorial compositions; stronger hierarchy and project differentiation across the matched captures and supplied reference direction.

criteria.description: Readable typography, spacing, density, and long Polish labels
criteria.observations: Clear display/body hierarchy and good long-label wrapping; secondary labels and annotations are small in places.

criteria.description: Coherent supplied palette, components, and interaction states
criteria.observations: Palette, original identity, diagrams, cards, navigation and contact states form a coherent visual system across inspected purposes and viewports.

criteria.description: Useful, honestly labeled diagrams/imagery and purposeful motion
criteria.observations: Distinct sensing/field and workflow illustrations explain project identity more effectively. Concept labels remain honest; graphics repeat within branches and are not real research assets.

criteria.description: Complete company investment and evidence journey
criteria.observations: Home -> Investors -> project evidence -> investment enquiry works in EN/PL across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Useful company/evidence links; the reader still assembles the comparison across several pages. Receipt capability is scored only under enquiry.

criteria.description: Complete technical partner and AIFIELD demo journeys
criteria.observations: Technical-entry partnership and AIFIELD demo paths work across all three engines and both locales; intent is editable and demo project is prefilled. Partnership handoff keeps the intent but the visitor must add the particular technical context; demo is an enquiry, not access to a product.

criteria.description: Direct arrivals, navigation, refresh, language switching, history, and recovery
criteria.observations: All 34 direct routes render; internal links/fragments, all 17 paired language switches, refresh, Back/Forward, legacy entries, 404 recovery, and mobile keyboard menus pass the observed checks.

criteria.description: Useful enquiry context, validation, truthful acceptance/failure, retry, and email fallback
criteria.observations: Validation, draft generation, editing and public email fallback work, but no enquiry is submitted or received. The server rejects write requests; users copy text into their email app. This is a major missing shared capability (B-01), distinct from missing live credentials. Partial credit reflects usable preparation and truthful status.

criteria.description: Clear company-level investment story and appropriate audience focus
criteria.observations: Company-level investment is clearly distinguished from project proposals. The opportunity is framed cautiously and coherently, but the business narrative remains broad. Missing owner-supplied commercial facts are recorded as external dependencies, not invented or counted as defects.

criteria.description: Substantive project detail and coverage of proposed page purposes, allowing justified consolidation
criteria.observations: Substantive coverage of all 17 purposes in both languages, including separate technology, applications, validation, workflow and neural-research discussions; no placeholder branches or unexplained consolidation.

criteria.description: Accurate, qualified facts, evidence, maturity, asset captions, and commercial statements
criteria.observations: Reviewed project content preserves simulation/physical/clinical boundaries, classical tools/neural research, human review, proposed relationships and historical budgets. No material unsupported claim found in the reviewed EN/PL copy. Concept illustrations are labeled. This is a source-grounded draft assessment, not scientific or owner approval.

criteria.description: Equivalent substantive English and Polish content, interface text, and error states
criteria.observations: Substantive EN/PL pages, localized navigation, metadata and form states are present and coherent under AI review. Technical copy can be dense; publication-quality Polish fluency and terminology await an independent human reviewer.

criteria.description: Readable desktop/mobile/narrow/short layouts without blocked content
criteria.observations: All 34 routes at desktop/mobile and all 17 Polish purposes at narrow/short viewports have no horizontal page overflow or observed blocked content. Real devices remain outside this evaluation; native zoom is accounted for separately.

criteria.description: Keyboard operation, visible focus, sensible order, and usable menus
criteria.observations: Keyboard menu opening/closure passes across three engines in both locales. Skip link, visible focus, form entry/validation and accessible-tree snapshots support keyboard use on the core paths; no blocking trap observed.

criteria.description: Meaningful structure, labels, alternatives, and screen-reader feedback
criteria.observations: Labels and accessibility trees are usable in the inspected states. Axe finds preview content outside landmarks across all 68 combinations and a heading-level skip on Projects in both locales/viewports (two underlying best-practice defects). Actual screen-reader operation remains untested; criterion is unrated.
criteria.unresolved_reason: Required actual screen-reader/native zoom evidence missing; observed evidence retained without inventing a complete rating.

criteria.description: Readable contrast, zoom, reduced motion, and perceivable form status/errors
criteria.observations: Contrast checks, localized perceivable errors and reduced-motion behavior pass observed tests. Native 200% browser zoom was not performed. CSS zoom is an inconclusive proxy and is not scored as a native-zoom defect. Criterion left unrated under the frozen missing-evidence rule.
criteria.unresolved_reason: Required actual screen-reader/native zoom evidence missing; observed evidence retained without inventing a complete rating.

criteria.description: Reproducible documented install, build, and start
criteria.observations: Dependency installation, production build and local serving succeed from the evaluation copy with the documented compatible runtime. Setup workarounds concern evaluator cache/sandbox conditions, not application source repairs.

criteria.description: Proportionate shared presentation and content ownership with manageable duplication
criteria.observations: Compact generation, shared render helpers, reusable technical content and one browser script suit the static site. Company copy embedded in a large render module makes content/presentation ownership less clear than a uniformly structured content layer.

criteria.description: Appropriate configuration, private/public boundaries, and enquiry data handling
criteria.observations: Only generated public files are served; tested private/source paths return 404. Draft values stay in page memory, mailto contains only the address, and the server rejects writes. The absent receiver is scored under enquiry, not penalized twice here.

criteria.description: Useful verification, accurate result claims, and actionable setup/blocker documentation
criteria.observations: README accurately documents setup, local drafting limits, verification scope, publication prerequisites and the work still needed for receipt. Seven supplied structural tests pass. Draft-only behavior is not represented as delivery.

criteria.description: Observed loading responsiveness under the fixed test profile
criteria.observations: Median LCP 2.101 s (1.651-2.551 s); median Lighthouse performance score 99 (95-100). Responsive in the lab, with materially more loading delay than A on the same profile.

criteria.description: Observed layout stability during loading and interaction
criteria.observations: All 30 cold mobile lab samples have CLS 0 and total blocking time 0. No loading shift observed in the matched captures; these are lab measurements, not field Core Web Vitals.

criteria.description: Efficient assets, requests, and transferred bytes for supplied content
criteria.observations: Median transferred bytes 181,424 (116,463-282,622), about 3.46 times A. Local fonts/visual assets remain modest in absolute terms but leave a clear efficiency opportunity.

criteria.description: Consistent mobile results across representative pages and repeated measurements
criteria.observations: Three measurements of each of five representative page purposes in both languages complete without errors and show tightly repeated per-URL results under the same pinned conditions.

criteria.description: Appropriate localized page titles and descriptions
criteria.observations: All 34 pages have distinct localized titles and nonempty descriptions; supplied structural tests and independent rendered checks agree.

criteria.description: Coherent canonicals and reciprocal language relationships
criteria.observations: All 34 pages have matching canonicals and reciprocal en/pl/x-default annotations in the local configuration.

criteria.description: Accurate sitemap/route membership and unknown-route behavior
criteria.observations: All mapped pages and internal fragments resolve; five legacy entries and four ArtiSense fragments work. Unknown routes return real localized 404s. Preview sitemap is intentionally empty.

criteria.description: Preview visibility matches intent and source/private materials stay outside public output
criteria.observations: Noindex metadata/headers, disallowing robots and empty sitemap match preview intent. Source/private paths tested return 404. This does not certify an untested future deployment.

critical_gates.description: Both required languages and both project branches are present
Core navigation and contact access work, including mobile and keyboard
Receipt is claimed only after acceptance
critical_gates.observations: A claims only explicitly local synthetic receipt; B claims only draft preparation. Missing receipt in B is a capability gap, not false success.

critical_gates.description: No observed exposure of private material
No material invented business or scientific evidence

limitations: Draft local preview; observed critical gates pass. Full accessibility certification is not claimed.

Also requires a server-side receiver implementation; not solely an external credential blocker.
Factual/translation/asset and privacy approvals, live delivery configuration, destination and release authorization unresolved.

instruction_compliance.limitation: Scoped assessment, not an exhaustive contract/rule audit. Detailed-only process and adapter requirements do not raise the shared website score.

measurement_limitations: Counts tool calls visible in the recording. Nested operations inside functions.exec are not separately certified.
Tool wait uses recording timestamps and is not a precise CPU execution timer; overlapping waits are merged.
Response records exclude failed/retried requests without usage; gateway logs are needed for total request attempts.
User-role messages and interrupted turns are observations, not an automatic count of human interventions.
Reasoning tokens are a subset of output tokens. Exact hidden-reasoning duration is unavailable.
No dollar cost is inferred. Correlate response IDs with verified gateway spend records.

The collector does not parse numeric lifecycle timestamps and reports zero turn-union time for these recordings. Evaluation normalizes Unix timestamps before calling it and uses recorded duration_ms for delivery wall time.
Manifest dispatched_at was recorded after actual task start; it cannot establish queue delay.
Human follow-ups after first delivery are excluded. User-role records in the baseline are automatic environment updates, not human implementation interventions.
Common and variant-specific preparation tokens/operator time/dollars unavailable. Total preparation-plus-execution comparison remains incomplete.
Recorded turn-union time has one-second precision; use recorded duration_ms for delivery wall time.
No actual screen reader, native zoom, independent human Polish review, real device or live mailbox used. Provider failures injected at browser boundary do not establish live provider behavior.
Browser engine versions for Firefox/WebKit were not saved. Playwright package version and installed engine family are known.

most_consequential_differences: Stronger visual composition and project illustrations
